name: Lecture Notes
description: Structured study notes: topics, definitions, examples and takeaways.
outline: Give the lecture a short title that names its subject, as a level-one heading.
Organize the content under headings that follow the order of the lecture.
Write definitions and key terms in bold, followed by a one-line explanation.
Include examples, formulas or case studies the lecturer used.
End with the main takeaways and any homework, readings or exam hints that were mentioned.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
# Photosynthesis
## Key Terms
- **Chlorophyll**: pigment that absorbs light

## Takeaways
- Light reactions feed the Calvin cycle
